author: DanHatrov

title: Sigh
body:
Could be good! More payment period options for pro could be fine. It’s either nothing or a year? Is there really no in between? 0,99 per month would be stellar, and you’d still get more than your year’s worth of money if people decided to stay. And they would… if it worked. 

The app is DEEPLY flawed. I set up my shortcut according to instructions and instead of getting a breathing notification when opening my app, I was stuck in an endless instruction screen limbo. No matter how many times I disabled it from the Settings or clicked “done” after reading the instructions… it would just open that page all over again. Im way more stressed now and should’ve just gone to Instagram to begin with. 

Just make a note saying “breathe” and make a shortcut to that. Works better, is free, and doesn’t drain your energy.
